items.question: How do I add a new expense?
items.answer: Open the Transactions page and log an amount, category and date, it appears in your dashboard instantly.

items.question: Can I track savings alongside spending?
items.answer: Yes, Savings is treated as its own category so contributions count toward your monthly goal just like any other budget line.

items.question: Does Centsible support multiple budgets per category?
items.answer: Each category gets one monthly budget that resets automatically, giving you a clean, simple limit to watch.

items.question: What happens when I go over budget?
items.answer: The category card switches to an over-budget state and the monthly summary flags it so you can adjust before the next cycle.
